345: (defn execute-expr-core-timed-part
346:  "Performs the part of execute-expr where we actually measure the elapsed run
347:   time.  Evaluates `(f)` `n` times, each time saving the return value as an
348:   Object in `mutable-place`.
349: 
350:   The idea is that except for the call to (f), the only things done during each
351:   iteration are a few arithmetic operations and comparisons to 0 on primitive
352:   longs, and the storage of the return value.
353: 
354:   The JVM is not free to optimize away the calls to f because the return values
355:   are saved in `mutable-place`."
356:   [n f]
357:   (time-body
358:    (loop [i (long (dec n))
359:           v (f)]
360:      (set-place mutable-place v)
361:      (if (pos? i)
362:        (recur (unchecked-dec i) (f))
363:        v))))
364: 
365: ;;; ## Execution
366: (defn execute-expr
367:   "Time the execution of `n` invocations of `f`. See
368:   `execute-expr-core-timed-part`."
369:   [n f]
370:   (let [time-and-ret (execute-expr-core-timed-part n f)]
371:     (get-place mutable-place) ;; just for good measure, use the mutable value
372:     time-and-ret))
373: 
374: (defn collect-samples
375:   [sample-count execution-count f gc-before-sample]
376:   {:pre [(pos? sample-count)]}
377:   (let [result (object-array sample-count)]
378:     (loop [i (long 0)]
379:       (if (< i sample-count)
380:         (do
381:           (when gc-before-sample
382:             (force-gc))
383:           (aset result i (execute-expr execution-count f))
384:           (recur (unchecked-inc i)))
385:         result))))

388: (defn warmup-for-jit
389:   "Run expression for the given amount of time to enable JIT compilation."
390:   [warmup-period f]
391:   (progress "Warming up for JIT optimisations" warmup-period "...")
392:   (let [cl-state (jvm-class-loader-state)
393:         comp-state (jvm-compilation-state)
394:         t (max 1 (first (time-body (f))))
395:         _ (debug "  initial t" t)
396:         [t n] (if (< t 100000)           ; 100us
397:                 (let [n (/ 100000 t)]
398:                   [(first (execute-expr n f)) n])
399:                 [t 1])
400:         p (/ warmup-period t)
401:         c (long (max 1 (* n (/ p 5))))]
402:     (debug "  using t" t "n" n)
403:     (debug "  using execution-count" c)
404:     (loop [elapsed (long t)
405:            count (long n)
406:            delta-free (long 0)
407:            old-cl-state cl-state
408:            old-comp-state comp-state]
409:       (let [new-cl-state (jvm-class-loader-state)
410:             new-comp-state (jvm-compilation-state)]
411:         (if (not= old-cl-state new-cl-state)
412:           (progress "  classes loaded before" count "iterations"))
413:         (if (not= old-comp-state new-comp-state)
414:           (progress "  compilation occurred before" count "iterations"))
415:         (debug "  elapsed" elapsed " count" count)
416:         (if (and (> delta-free 2) (> elapsed warmup-period))
417:           [elapsed count
418:            (state-delta new-cl-state cl-state)
419:            (state-delta new-comp-state comp-state)]
420:           (recur (+ elapsed (long (first (execute-expr c f))))
421:                  (+ count c)
422:                  (if (and (= old-cl-state new-cl-state)
423:                           (= old-comp-state new-comp-state))
424:                    (unchecked-inc delta-free)
425:                    (long 0))
426:                  new-cl-state
427:                  new-comp-state))))))

429: ;;; Execution parameters
430: (defn estimate-execution-count
431:   "Estimate the number of executions required in order to have at least the
432:    specified execution period, check for the jvm to have constant class loader
433:    and compilation state."
434:   [period f gc-before-sample estimated-fn-time]
435:   (progress "Estimating execution count ...")
436:   (debug " estimated-fn-time" estimated-fn-time)
437:   (loop [n (max 1 (long (/ period (max 1 estimated-fn-time) 5)))
438:          cl-state (jvm-class-loader-state)
439:          comp-state (jvm-compilation-state)]
440:     (let [t (ffirst (collect-samples 1 n f gc-before-sample))
441:           ;; It is possible for small n and a fast expression to get
442:           ;; t=0 nsec back from collect-samples.  This is likely due
443:           ;; to how (System/nanoTime) quantizes the time on some
444:           ;; systems.
445:           t (max 1 t)
446:           new-cl-state (jvm-class-loader-state)
447:           new-comp-state (jvm-compilation-state)]
448:       (debug " ..." n)
449:       (when (not= comp-state new-comp-state)
450:         (warn "new compilations in execution estimation phase"))
451:       (if (and (>= t period)
452:                (= cl-state new-cl-state)
453:                (= comp-state new-comp-state))
454:         n
455:         (recur (if (>= t period)
456:                  n
457:                  (min (* 2 n) (inc (long (* n (/ period t))))))
458:                new-cl-state new-comp-state)))))

461: ;; benchmark
462: (defn run-benchmark
463:   "Benchmark an expression. This tries its best to eliminate sources of error.
464:    This also means that it runs for a while.  It will typically take 70s for a
465:    quick test expression (less than 1s run time) or 10s plus 60 run times for
466:    longer running expressions."
467:   [sample-count warmup-jit-period target-execution-time f gc-before-sample
468:    overhead]
469:   (force-gc)
470:   (let [first-execution (time-body (f))
471:         [warmup-t warmup-n cl-state comp-state] (warmup-for-jit
472:                                                  warmup-jit-period f)
473:         n-exec (estimate-execution-count
474:                 target-execution-time f gc-before-sample
475:                 (long (/ warmup-t warmup-n)))
476:         total-overhead (long (* (or overhead 0) 1e9 n-exec))
477:         _   (progress "Sampling ...")
478:         _   (debug
479:              "Running with\n sample-count" sample-count \newline
480:              "exec-count" n-exec \newline
481:              "overhead[s]" overhead \newline
482:              "total-overhead[ns]" total-overhead)
483:         _   (force-gc)
484:         samples (collect-samples sample-count n-exec f gc-before-sample)
485:         final-gc-time (final-gc)
486:         sample-times (->> samples
487:                           (map first)
488:                           (map #(- % total-overhead)))
489:         total (reduce + 0 sample-times)
490:         final-gc-result (final-gc-warn total final-gc-time)]
491:     {:execution-count n-exec
492:      :sample-count sample-count
493:      :samples sample-times
494:      :results (map second samples)
495:      :total-time (/ total 1e9)
496:      :warmup-time warmup-t
497:      :warmup-executions warmup-n
498:      :final-gc-time final-gc-time
499:      :overhead overhead}))

751: (defn benchmark-stats [times opts]
752:   (let [outliers (outliers (:samples times))
753:         tail-quantile (:tail-quantile opts)
754:         stats (bootstrap-bca
755:                (map double (:samples times))
756:                (juxt
757:                 mean
758:                 variance
759:                 (partial quantile tail-quantile)
760:                 (partial quantile (- 1.0 tail-quantile)))
761:                (:bootstrap-size opts) [0.5 tail-quantile (- 1.0 tail-quantile)]
762:                criterium.well/well-rng-1024a)
763:         analysis (outlier-significance (first stats) (second stats)
764:                                        (:sample-count times))
765:         sqr (fn [x] (* x x))
766:         m (mean (map double (:samples times)))
767:         s (Math/sqrt (variance (map double (:samples times))))]
768:     (merge times
769:            {:outliers outliers
770:             :mean (scale-bootstrap-estimate
771:                    (first stats) (/ 1e-9 (:execution-count times)))
772:             :sample-mean (scale-bootstrap-estimate
773:                           [m [(- m (* 3 s)) (+ m (* 3 s))]]
774:                           (/ 1e-9 (:execution-count times)))
775:             :variance (scale-bootstrap-estimate
776:                        (second stats) (sqr (/ 1e-9 (:execution-count times))))
777:             :sample-variance (scale-bootstrap-estimate
778:                               [ (sqr s) [0 0]]
779:                               (sqr (/ 1e-9 (:execution-count times))))
780:             :lower-q (scale-bootstrap-estimate
781:                        (nth stats 2) (/ 1e-9 (:execution-count times)))
782:             :upper-q (scale-bootstrap-estimate
783:                        (nth stats 3) (/ 1e-9 (:execution-count times)))
784:             :outlier-variance analysis
785:             :tail-quantile (:tail-quantile opts)
786:             :os-details (os-details)
787:             :options opts
788:             :runtime-details (->
789:                               (runtime-details)
790:                               (update-in [:input-arguments] vec))})))

806:   "Benchmark a function. This tries its best to eliminate sources of error.

808:    fast test expression (less than 1s run time) or 10s plus 60 run times for

(ns evidence.host-cost
  "Finite diagnostic for real host queue production/consumption; no window or tick."
  (:require
   [clojure.edn :as edn]
   [clojure.java.io :as io]
   [clojure.pprint :as pprint]
   [criterium.core :as criterium]
   [domain.ecs.components :as c]
   [domain.ecs.core :as ecs]
   [domain.player :as player]
   [domain.voxel.sculpt :as sculpt]
   [infra.dev.window.loop :as host]
   [infra.render.input :as input]
   [law.narrowing :as narrowing])
  (:import
   (java.io StringWriter)
   (java.lang.management ManagementFactory)
   (java.nio.file Files StandardOpenOption)
   (java.security MessageDigest)
   (java.util HexFormat)
   (java.util.concurrent ConcurrentLinkedQueue)))

(defn- sha-bytes [payload]
  (.formatHex (HexFormat/of) (.digest (MessageDigest/getInstance "SHA-256") payload)))

(defn- write-new! [path value]
  (let [text (with-out-str (pprint/pprint value))
        payload (.getBytes text "UTF-8")
        readback (try {:value (edn/read-string text)}
                      (catch Exception error {:error error}))]
    (when-not (and (nil? (:error readback)) (= value (:value readback)))
      (let [rejected (io/file (str path ".rejected.edn"))]
        (Files/write (.toPath rejected) payload
                     (into-array StandardOpenOption [StandardOpenOption/CREATE_NEW
                                                     StandardOpenOption/WRITE]))
        (throw (ex-info "Evidence must round-trip without coercion; attempted text preserved"
                        {:rejected (str rejected)} (:error readback)))))
    (Files/write (.toPath (io/file path)) payload
                 (into-array StandardOpenOption [StandardOpenOption/CREATE_NEW
                                                 StandardOpenOption/WRITE]))))

(defn- fixture-world [spec]
  (let [[w observer] (player/spawn-observer (ecs/empty-world) (:observer-position spec))
        [w planet] (ecs/spawn w)]
    (-> w
        (ecs/put-component observer c/velocity (:observer-velocity spec))
        (ecs/put-component observer c/palette narrowing/planetary-palette)
        (player/update-observer assoc :id (:observer-id spec)
                                :resonance (:resonance spec))
        (ecs/put-components planet {c/position (:planet-position spec)
                                    c/velocity (:planet-velocity spec)
                                    c/mass (:planet-mass spec)
                                    c/radius (:planet-radius spec)
                                    c/body-kind :body/planet
                                    c/commitment-state :committed})
        (player/focus-follow (get-in spec [:config :focus-offset])))))

(defn- physical-columns [world]
  (select-keys (:components world)
               [c/position c/velocity c/mass c/radius c/body-kind
                c/orientation c/angular-velocity]))

(defn- expected-world [world {:keys [kind] entry-count :count}]
  (case kind
    :empty world
    :legacy (assoc world :host-cost/trace (vec (range entry-count)))
    :sculpt (nth (iterate #(sculpt/request-op % :uplift 0.5) world) entry-count)))

(defn- required-var [symbol-name]
  (or (requiring-resolve symbol-name)
      (throw (ex-info "Required actual host function missing" {:name symbol-name}))))

(defn- make-case [revision world cfg {:keys [kind] entry-count :count :as spec}]
  (let [drain (required-var 'infra.dev.window.loop/drain-intents)
        dispatch #'input/dispatch-palette-action!
        contextual? (= revision :candidate)
        context-fn (when contextual? (required-var 'infra.dev.window.loop/iteration-context))
        enqueue (when contextual? (required-var 'infra.dev.window.loop/enqueue-contextual!))
        published (atom world)
        config (atom cfg)
        queue (ConcurrentLinkedQueue.)
        intents (host/->IntentAtom queue published)
        options (when contextual? {:submit-contextual! (partial enqueue intents)})
        expected [(expected-world world spec) world true]
        f (fn []
            ;; The real host retains its queue, IntentAtom and capability.
            ;; Every invocation drains completely; only candidate projects C_n.
            (assert (.isEmpty queue) "Invocation started with pending entries")
            (let [current-config @config
                  context (when contextual? (context-fn current-config))]
              (case kind
                :empty nil
                :legacy (dotimes [i entry-count]
                          (swap! intents update :host-cost/trace (fnil conj []) i))
                :sculpt (dotimes [_ entry-count]
                          ;; GLFW_KEY_T =84: ordinary pure dispatch, no GLFW call.
                          (if contextual?
                            (dispatch config intents 84 false options)
                            (dispatch config intents 84 false))))
              (let [result (if contextual? (drain world queue context) (drain world queue))]
                (assert (.isEmpty queue) "Invocation left pending entries")
                (assert (identical? world @published) "Invocation changed published fixture")
                (assert (identical? cfg @config) "Invocation changed host config")
                [result @published true])))
        check (fn [result]
                (assert (= expected result) "Exact queue/world equivalence failed")
                (assert (identical? world @published) "Published fixture mutated")
                (assert (identical? cfg @config) "Host config mutated")
                (assert (= (physical-columns world) (physical-columns (first result)))
                        "Queue workload changed physical columns")
                (when (= kind :sculpt)
                  (assert (= entry-count (count (:voxel/sculpt-ops (first result))))
                          "Paid Sculpt workload did not execute every action")
                  (assert (= (- (:resonance (player/get-observer world)) (* 2.0 entry-count))
                             (:resonance (player/get-observer (first result))))
                          "Unexpected fixed uplift cost"))
                result)]
    {:label (:label spec) :f f :check check :expected expected}))

(defn- thread-samples [f check]
  (let [^com.sun.management.ThreadMXBean metrics (ManagementFactory/getThreadMXBean)
        thread-id (.getId (Thread/currentThread))]
    (assert (and (.isCurrentThreadCpuTimeSupported metrics)
                 (.isThreadCpuTimeEnabled metrics)
                 (.isThreadAllocatedMemorySupported metrics)
                 (.isThreadAllocatedMemoryEnabled metrics))
            "Required current-thread counters unavailable")
    (mapv (fn [index]
            (let [cpu0 (.getCurrentThreadCpuTime metrics)
                  bytes0 (.getThreadAllocatedBytes metrics thread-id)
                  [wall result] (criterium/execute-expr 1000 f)
                  bytes1 (.getThreadAllocatedBytes metrics thread-id)
                  cpu1 (.getCurrentThreadCpuTime metrics)]
              (check result)
              {:index index :repetitions 1000
               :cpu-ns-per-invocation (/ (- cpu1 cpu0) 1000.0)
               :bytes-per-invocation (/ (- bytes1 bytes0) 1000.0)
               :wall-ns-per-invocation (/ wall 1000.0)
               :last-result-hash (hash result)}))
          (range 20))))

(defn- median [values]
  (let [v (vec (sort values)) n (count v) middle (quot n 2)]
    (if (odd? n) (v middle) (/ (+ (v (dec middle)) (v middle)) 2.0))))

(defn- robust-summary [samples metric-key]
  (let [v (vec (sort (map metric-key samples))) m (median v) n (count v)]
    {:median m :minimum (first v) :maximum (peek v)
     :lower-quartile (median (subvec v 0 (quot n 2)))
     :upper-quartile (median (subvec v (quot n 2)))
     :median-absolute-deviation (median (map #(abs (- % m)) v))}))

(defn- measure [{:keys [label f check]}]
  (println "Measuring" label)
  (flush)
  (check (f))
  (let [result (criterium/quick-benchmark* f {})
        counts (:outliers result)
        _ (assert (instance? criterium.core.OutlierCount counts)
                  "Unexpected Criterium outlier representation")
        metrics (-> (select-keys result [:mean :variance :lower-q :upper-q
                                         :sample-mean :sample-variance :samples
                                         :sample-count :execution-count :total-time
                                         :warmup-executions :warmup-time :options
                                         :outlier-variance :final-gc-time :overhead])
                    (assoc :outliers {:record-type "criterium.core.OutlierCount"
                                      :fields (into {} counts)}))
        samples (thread-samples f check)]
    (check (f))
    {:label label :criterium metrics :thread-samples samples
     :summary (into {} (map (fn [metric-key] [metric-key (robust-summary samples metric-key)]))
                    [:cpu-ns-per-invocation :bytes-per-invocation :wall-ns-per-invocation])
     :scope "Includes enqueue/dispatch, context, drain, common queue/identity assertions and output wrapper/sink; persistent host objects initialized outside timing; no tick/render cost."}))

(defn- verify-loaded-resources! [folder revision]
  (let [pins (edn/read-string (slurp (io/file folder "loaded-source-pins.edn")))
        selected (get pins revision)]
    (assert (seq selected) "Unknown source revision")
    (into {}
          (map (fn [[resource expected]]
                 (let [url (io/resource resource)
                       actual (with-open [stream (io/input-stream url)]
                                (sha-bytes (.readAllBytes stream)))]
                   (assert (= expected actual) (str "Wrong compiled source resource " resource))
                   [resource {:sha256 actual :url (str url)}])))
          selected)))

(defn -main
  "Run four pinned queue cases once; external supervisor owns the absolute deadline."
  [revision-name folder out baseline-checks baseline-checks-sha]
  (let [revision (keyword revision-name)
        stderr (StringWriter.)]
    (try
      (let [resources (verify-loaded-resources! folder revision)
            spec (edn/read-string (slurp (io/file folder "fixture.edn")))
            world (fixture-world spec)
            _ (assert (= world (edn/read-string (pr-str world))) "World EDN round-trip failed")
            cases (mapv #(make-case revision world (:config spec) %) (:cases spec))
            outputs (binding [*err* stderr]
                      (mapv (fn [{:keys [label f check]}] [label (check (f))]) cases))
            checks {:input-world world :config (:config spec) :outputs outputs}
            _ (when (= revision :candidate)
                (let [payload (Files/readAllBytes (.toPath (io/file baseline-checks)))]
                  (assert (= baseline-checks-sha (sha-bytes payload))
                          "Baseline output changed after supervisor admission")
                  (assert (= checks (edn/read-string (String. payload "UTF-8")))

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
PROC = Path("/proc")
WORK_SECONDS = 170.0
TOTAL_SECONDS = 180.0
LABEL = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,48}\Z")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def utc():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def error_info(error):
    return {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}


def membership(pid):
    """Read authoritative group/start identity; only a vanished stat means absent."""
    try:
        fields = (PROC / str(pid) / "stat").read_text().rsplit(") ", 1)[1].split()
        return {"pid": pid, "state": fields[0], "pgid": int(fields[2]),
                "starttime_ticks": int(fields[19])}
    except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
        return None


def identity(pid):
    result = membership(pid)
    if result is None:
        return None
    result["metadata_errors"] = {}
    for name in ["exe", "cwd"]:
        try:
            result[name] = os.readlink(PROC / str(pid) / name)
        except OSError as error:
            result[name] = None
            result["metadata_errors"][name] = error_info(error)
    return result


def group_members(pgid):
    result = {"members": [], "unreadable": []}
    try:
        paths = list(PROC.iterdir())
    except OSError as error:
        result["unreadable"].append({"path": str(PROC), **error_info(error)})
        return result
    for path in paths:
        if path.name.isdecimal():
            pid = int(path.name)
            try:
                item = membership(pid)
            except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError) as error:
                result["unreadable"].append({"pid": pid, **error_info(error)})
                continue
            if item and item["pgid"] == pgid:
                result["members"].append(item)
    return result


def load_snapshot():
    java = []
    for path in PROC.iterdir():
        if path.name.isdecimal():
            try:
                executable = os.readlink(path / "exe")
            except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                continue
            if Path(executable).name == "java":
                java.append(identity(int(path.name)))
    return {"at": utc(), "loadavg": Path("/proc/loadavg").read_text().strip(),
            "aggregate_cpu": Path("/proc/stat").read_text().splitlines()[0],
            "visible_java_identities": [x for x in java if x is not None],
            "limit": "Endpoint census, not continuous proof of isolation; no commandlines/environment read."}


def write_new(path, value):
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


def verify_pins():
    prep = json.loads((HERE / "preparation-hashes.json").read_text())
    for relative, expected in prep.items():
        assert digest(HERE / relative) == expected, f"Preparation changed: {relative}"
    pins = json.loads((HERE / "source-pins.json").read_text())
    for relative, expected in pins["candidate"].items():
        assert digest(ROOT / relative) == expected, f"Source changed: {relative}"
    for relative in pins["baseline_overlay_paths"]:
        overlay = HERE / "baseline-overlay" / Path(relative).relative_to("src")
        assert digest(overlay) == pins["baseline"][relative], f"Wrong baseline overlay: {relative}"
    audit = json.loads((HERE / "criterium-source-audit.json").read_text())
    assert digest(Path(audit["jar"])) == audit["jar_sha256"], "Criterium jar changed"
    return pins, prep


def main():
    started = time.monotonic()
    started_utc = utc()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("revision", choices=["baseline", "candidate"])
    parser.add_argument("run_label")
    parser.add_argument("--baseline-run")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert LABEL.fullmatch(args.run_label), "Invalid fresh run label"
    assert args.baseline_run is None or LABEL.fullmatch(args.baseline_run), "Invalid baseline label"
    assert (args.revision == "candidate") == (args.baseline_run is not None), "Candidate requires completed baseline"
    out = HERE / "runs" / args.run_label
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    work_deadline = started + WORK_SECONDS
    total_deadline = started + TOTAL_SECONDS
    child = None
    observations = {}
    history = []
    error = None
    timed_out = False
    rc = None
    argv = None
    source_changed = []
    prep_changed = []
    cleanup = []
    cleanup_errors = []
    membership_unknown = []
    primary_identity = None
    pins = None
    prep = None
    journal = out / "ownership.jsonl"
    journal.touch(exist_ok=False)

    def record_event(event):
        with journal.open("a") as stream:
            json.dump(dict(event, at=utc(), elapsed_s=time.monotonic() - started), stream)
            stream.write("\n")
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())

    def observe(pid):
        item = identity(pid)
        if item is None:
            return
        previous = observations.get(pid)
        if previous != item:
            history.append(dict(item, elapsed_s=time.monotonic() - started))
            record_event({"event": "identity", "identity": item})
        observations[pid] = item
        try:
            descendants = (PROC / str(pid) / "task" / str(pid) / "children").read_text().split()
        except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
            return item
        for descendant in descendants:
            observe(int(descendant))
        return item

    def cleanup_call(stage, function, default=None):
        try:
            return function()
        except BaseException as failure:
            cleanup_errors.append({"stage": stage, **error_info(failure)})
            return default

    def scan_owned():
        result = cleanup_call("scan-owned-group", lambda: group_members(child.pid),
                              {"members": [], "unreadable": [{"reason": "Group scan failed"}]})
        for unknown in result["unreadable"]:
            if unknown not in membership_unknown:
                membership_unknown.append(unknown)
        return result["members"]

    def signal_owned(number):
        leader = membership(child.pid)

                and leader["starttime_ticks"] != primary_identity["starttime_ticks"]):
            raise RuntimeError("Owned group leader PID was reused; refusing signal")
        if primary_identity is None and child.poll() is not None:
            raise RuntimeError("Missing primary start identity after exit; refusing group signal")

            os.killpg(child.pid, number)

        except ProcessLookupError:

    def interrupt(_number, _frame):
        raise InterruptedError("Supervisor interrupted; owned cleanup required")

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupt)
    try:
        pins, prep = verify_pins()
        baseline_checks, baseline_hash = "-", "-"
        if args.baseline_run:
            previous = HERE / "runs" / args.baseline_run
            previous_execution = json.loads((previous / "execution.json").read_text())
            assert previous_execution["status"] == "complete", "Baseline measurement did not complete"
            assert previous_execution["revision"] == "baseline", "Comparison source is not baseline"
            assert previous_execution["preparation_hashes"] == prep, "Baseline used different preparation"
            baseline_checks = str(previous / "checks.edn")
            baseline_hash = previous_execution["artifacts"]["checks.edn"]
            assert digest(Path(baseline_checks)) == baseline_hash, "Baseline checks changed"
        write_new(out / "load-before.json", load_snapshot())
        paths = ([str(HERE / "baseline-overlay")] if args.revision == "baseline" else [])
        paths += [str(ROOT / "src"), str(ROOT / "resources"), str(HERE)]
        deps = '{:paths [' + ' '.join(json.dumps(x) for x in paths) + '] :deps {criterium/criterium {:mvn/version "0.4.6"}}}'
        argv = ["clojure", "-Srepro", "-Sdeps", deps, "-M", "-m", "evidence.host-cost",
                args.revision, str(HERE), str(out), baseline_checks, baseline_hash]
        env = os.environ.copy()
        for key in ["JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS", "_JAVA_OPTIONS", "CLJ_JVM_OPTS"]:
            env.pop(key, None)
        env["JAVA_OPTS"] = "-Xms256m -Xmx2g"
        assert time.monotonic() < work_deadline, "Preflight exhausted work budget"
        write_new(out / "command.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(ROOT), "started_utc": started_utc,
                                         "java_opts": env["JAVA_OPTS"], "work_s": WORK_SECONDS,
                                         "total_s": TOTAL_SECONDS, "baseline_checks_sha256": baseline_hash})
        with (out / "stdout.log").open("xb") as stdout, (out / "stderr.log").open("xb") as stderr:
            child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                     stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
            record_event({"event": "spawn", "pid": child.pid, "expected_pgid": child.pid,
                          "start_new_session": True})
            primary_identity = observe(child.pid)
            assert primary_identity is not None, "Primary start identity unavailable; spawn PID retained"
            assert primary_identity["pgid"] == child.pid, "Primary was not in its promised new process group"
            write_new(out / "primary-identity.json", primary_identity)
            while child.poll() is None:
                observe(child.pid)
                if time.monotonic() >= work_deadline:
                    timed_out = True
                    raise TimeoutError("170s work budget exhausted; partial results retained, no retry")
                time.sleep(min(0.1, max(0.0, work_deadline - time.monotonic())))
            rc = child.wait()
            if time.monotonic() >= work_deadline:
                timed_out = True
                raise TimeoutError("Child completion exceeded170s work deadline; late output retained as failed")
        assert rc == 0, f"Host-cost JVM exited {rc}"
        assert (out / "complete.edn").is_file(), "No complete marker"
        for name in ["checks.edn", "loaded-resources.edn", "empty.edn", "legacy-16.edn", "sculpt-1.edn", "sculpt-8.edn"]:
            assert (out / name).is_file(), f"Missing evidence {name}"
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = error_info(exc)
    finally:
        # Never retry the workload. Signals during cleanup must not skip reap.
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        if child is not None:
            cleanup_call("observe-before-cleanup", lambda: observe(child.pid))
            remaining = scan_owned()
            if cleanup_call("poll-before-cleanup", child.poll) is None or remaining:
                cleanup_call("terminate-owned-group", lambda: signal_owned(signal.SIGTERM))
                end_grace = min(total_deadline - 2.0, time.monotonic() + 8.0)

                    cleanup_call("kill-owned-group", lambda: signal_owned(signal.SIGKILL))
            rc = cleanup_call("reap-owned-primary", lambda: child.wait(
                timeout=max(0.001, total_deadline - time.monotonic())), rc)
        live_group = scan_owned() if child is not None else []
        live_observed = []
        for pid, old in observations.items():
            now = cleanup_call(f"check-observed-{pid}", lambda pid=pid: membership(pid))
            if now and now["starttime_ticks"] == old["starttime_ticks"]:

        cleanup_call("record-cleanup", lambda: record_event({"event": "cleanup", "exit_code": rc,

        artifacts = cleanup_call("hash-artifacts", lambda: {p.name: digest(p) for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file()}, {})
        finished = time.monotonic()

        status = "complete" if (error is None and rc == 0 and not live_group and not live_observed
                                and not source_changed and not prep_changed and not timed_out
                                and not cleanup_errors and not membership_unknown
                                and not total_deadline_exceeded) else "failed"
        result = {"status": status, "revision": args.revision, "started_utc": started_utc,
                  "ended_utc": utc(), "elapsed_s": finished - started,
                  "work_budget_s": WORK_SECONDS, "total_budget_s": TOTAL_SECONDS,
                  "total_deadline_exceeded": total_deadline_exceeded,
                  "error": error, "timed_out": timed_out, "exit_code": rc,
                  "pid_pgid": child.pid if child is not None else None,
                  "primary_identity": primary_identity,

                  "observed_identities": history, "remaining_group": live_group,
                  "remaining_observed": live_observed, "cleanup": cleanup,
                  "cleanup_errors": cleanup_errors, "membership_unknown": membership_unknown,

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def stat_text(pid, pgid, start=9876):
    fields = ["S", "0", str(pgid)] + ["0"] * 16 + [str(start)]
    return f"{pid} (fake process) " + " ".join(fields) + "\n"


class Clock:
    def __init__(self):
        self.now = 0.0

    def monotonic(self):
        return self.now

    def sleep(self, seconds):
        self.now += seconds


class SupervisorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):

        self.addCleanup(self.stack.close)

        self.proc = self.tmp / "proc"
        self.proc.mkdir()
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("offline_host_supervisor", HERE / "supervisor.py")
        self.m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(self.m)
        self.m.HERE = self.tmp
        self.m.ROOT = self.tmp
        self.m.PROC = self.proc
        real_path = Path

        def mapped_path(value):
            text = str(value)
            if text == "/proc" or text.startswith("/proc/"):
                return self.proc / text.removeprefix("/proc").lstrip("/")
            return real_path(value)

        self.m.Path = mapped_path
        self.clock = Clock()
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.time, "monotonic", self.clock.monotonic))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.time, "sleep", self.clock.sleep))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(subprocess, "Popen", side_effect=AssertionError("Real Popen blocked")))

        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.os, "killpg", side_effect=AssertionError("Real signal blocked")))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.signal, "signal", return_value=None))
        self.links = {}

        def readlink(path):
            key = str(path).replace(str(self.proc), "/proc")
            if key in self.links:
                value = self.links[key]
                if isinstance(value, Exception):
                    raise value
                return value
            raise FileNotFoundError(key)

        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.os, "readlink", side_effect=readlink))
        self.add_proc(1, 1)
        self.links["/proc/1/exe"] = PermissionError("unrelated PID1 exe denied")
        self.links["/proc/1/cwd"] = PermissionError("unrelated PID1 cwd denied")

    def add_proc(self, pid, pgid, start=9876):
        path = self.proc / str(pid)
        path.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (path / "stat").write_text(stat_text(pid, pgid, start))
        child_dir = path / "task" / str(pid)
        child_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (child_dir / "children").write_text("")
        return path

    def deny_stat(self, pid):
        real_read = Path.read_text
        target = self.proc / str(pid) / "stat"

        def read(path, *args, **kwargs):
            if path == target:
                raise PermissionError("membership stat denied")
            return real_read(path, *args, **kwargs)

        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(Path, "read_text", read))

            def wait(self, timeout=None):

        self.assertTrue(result["primary_reaped"])
        self.assertTrue(result["membership_unknown"])

    def test_cleanup_scan_exception_still_reaps_and_records(self):
        rc, result, _, _ = self.run_main(cleanup_scan_error=True)
        self.assertEqual((rc, result["status"]), (1, "failed"))
        self.assertTrue(result["primary_reaped"])
        self.assertTrue(result["cleanup_errors"])
        self.assertTrue((self.tmp / "runs/test-run/ownership.jsonl").is_file())

    def test_missing_initial_identity_keeps_spawn_and_fails(self):
        rc, result, child, _ = self.run_main(missing_identity=True)
        self.assertEqual((rc, result["status"]), (1, "failed"))
        self.assertTrue(result["primary_reaped"])
        first = json.loads((self.tmp / "runs/test-run/ownership.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()[0])
        self.assertEqual(first["pid"], child.pid)

    def test_late_work_cannot_be_complete(self):
        rc, result, _, _ = self.run_main(late_work=True)
        self.assertEqual((rc, result["status"]), (1, "failed"))
        self.assertTrue(result["timed_out"])

    def test_late_final_verdict_cannot_be_complete(self):
        rc, result, _, _ = self.run_main(late_final=True)
        self.assertEqual((rc, result["status"]), (1, "failed"))
        self.assertTrue(result["total_deadline_exceeded"])

"""One explicitly released host-cost JVM; 170s work and 180s total, no retries."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
PROC = Path("/proc")
WORK_SECONDS = 170.0
TOTAL_SECONDS = 180.0
LABEL = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,48}\Z")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def utc():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def error_info(error):
    return {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}


def membership(pid):
    """Read authoritative group/start identity; only a vanished stat means absent."""
    try:
        fields = (PROC / str(pid) / "stat").read_text().rsplit(") ", 1)[1].split()
        return {"pid": pid, "state": fields[0], "pgid": int(fields[2]),
                "starttime_ticks": int(fields[19])}
    except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
        return None


def identity(pid):
    result = membership(pid)
    if result is None:
        return None
    result["metadata_errors"] = {}
    for name in ["exe", "cwd"]:
        try:
            result[name] = os.readlink(PROC / str(pid) / name)
        except OSError as error:
            result[name] = None
            result["metadata_errors"][name] = error_info(error)
    return result


def group_members(pgid):
    result = {"members": [], "unreadable": []}
    try:
        paths = list(PROC.iterdir())
    except OSError as error:
        result["unreadable"].append({"path": str(PROC), **error_info(error)})
        return result
    for path in paths:
        if path.name.isdecimal():
            pid = int(path.name)
            try:
                item = membership(pid)
            except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError) as error:
                result["unreadable"].append({"pid": pid, **error_info(error)})
                continue
            if item and item["pgid"] == pgid:
                result["members"].append(item)
    return result


def load_snapshot():
    java = []
    for path in PROC.iterdir():
        if path.name.isdecimal():
            try:
                executable = os.readlink(path / "exe")
            except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                continue
            if Path(executable).name == "java":
                java.append(identity(int(path.name)))
    return {"at": utc(), "loadavg": Path("/proc/loadavg").read_text().strip(),
            "aggregate_cpu": Path("/proc/stat").read_text().splitlines()[0],
            "visible_java_identities": [x for x in java if x is not None],
            "limit": "Endpoint census, not continuous proof of isolation; no commandlines/environment read."}


def write_new(path, value):
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


def verify_pins():
    prep = json.loads((HERE / "preparation-hashes.json").read_text())
    for relative, expected in prep.items():
        assert digest(HERE / relative) == expected, f"Preparation changed: {relative}"
    pins = json.loads((HERE / "source-pins.json").read_text())
    for relative, expected in pins["candidate"].items():
        assert digest(ROOT / relative) == expected, f"Source changed: {relative}"
    for relative in pins["baseline_overlay_paths"]:
        overlay = HERE / "baseline-overlay" / Path(relative).relative_to("src")
        assert digest(overlay) == pins["baseline"][relative], f"Wrong baseline overlay: {relative}"
    audit = json.loads((HERE / "criterium-source-audit.json").read_text())
    assert digest(Path(audit["jar"])) == audit["jar_sha256"], "Criterium jar changed"
    return pins, prep


def main():
    started = time.monotonic()
    started_utc = utc()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("revision", choices=["baseline", "candidate"])
    parser.add_argument("run_label")
    parser.add_argument("--baseline-run")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert LABEL.fullmatch(args.run_label), "Invalid fresh run label"
    assert args.baseline_run is None or LABEL.fullmatch(args.baseline_run), "Invalid baseline label"
    assert (args.revision == "candidate") == (args.baseline_run is not None), "Candidate requires completed baseline"
    out = HERE / "runs" / args.run_label
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    work_deadline = started + WORK_SECONDS
    total_deadline = started + TOTAL_SECONDS
    child = None
    observations = {}
    history = []
    error = None
    timed_out = False
    rc = None
    argv = None
    source_changed = []
    prep_changed = []
    cleanup = []
    cleanup_errors = []
    membership_unknown = []
    primary_identity = None
    pins = None
    prep = None
    journal = out / "ownership.jsonl"
    journal.touch(exist_ok=False)

    def record_event(event):
        with journal.open("a") as stream:
            json.dump(dict(event, at=utc(), elapsed_s=time.monotonic() - started), stream)
            stream.write("\n")
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())

    def observe(pid):
        item = identity(pid)
        if item is None:
            return
        previous = observations.get(pid)
        if previous != item:
            history.append(dict(item, elapsed_s=time.monotonic() - started))
            record_event({"event": "identity", "identity": item})
        observations[pid] = item
        try:
            descendants = (PROC / str(pid) / "task" / str(pid) / "children").read_text().split()
        except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
            return item
        for descendant in descendants:
            observe(int(descendant))
        return item

    def cleanup_call(stage, function, default=None):
        try:
            return function()
        except BaseException as failure:
            cleanup_errors.append({"stage": stage, **error_info(failure)})
            return default

    def scan_owned():
        result = cleanup_call("scan-owned-group", lambda: group_members(child.pid),
                              {"members": [], "unreadable": [{"reason": "Group scan failed"}]})
        for unknown in result["unreadable"]:
            if unknown not in membership_unknown:
                membership_unknown.append(unknown)
        return result["members"]

    def signal_owned(number):
        leader = membership(child.pid)
        if (leader and primary_identity
                and leader["starttime_ticks"] != primary_identity["starttime_ticks"]):
            raise RuntimeError("Owned group leader PID was reused; refusing signal")
        if primary_identity is None and child.poll() is not None:
            raise RuntimeError("Missing primary start identity after exit; refusing group signal")
        try:
            os.killpg(child.pid, number)
            cleanup.append(f"sent {number.name} to owned process group")
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass

    def interrupt(_number, _frame):
        raise InterruptedError("Supervisor interrupted; owned cleanup required")

    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupt)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupt)
    try:
        pins, prep = verify_pins()
        baseline_checks, baseline_hash = "-", "-"
        if args.baseline_run:
            previous = HERE / "runs" / args.baseline_run
            previous_execution = json.loads((previous / "execution.json").read_text())
            assert previous_execution["status"] == "complete", "Baseline measurement did not complete"
            assert previous_execution["revision"] == "baseline", "Comparison source is not baseline"
            assert previous_execution["preparation_hashes"] == prep, "Baseline used different preparation"
            baseline_checks = str(previous / "checks.edn")
            baseline_hash = previous_execution["artifacts"]["checks.edn"]
            assert digest(Path(baseline_checks)) == baseline_hash, "Baseline checks changed"
        write_new(out / "load-before.json", load_snapshot())
        paths = ([str(HERE / "baseline-overlay")] if args.revision == "baseline" else [])
        paths += [str(ROOT / "src"), str(ROOT / "resources"), str(HERE)]
        deps = '{:paths [' + ' '.join(json.dumps(x) for x in paths) + '] :deps {criterium/criterium {:mvn/version "0.4.6"}}}'
        argv = ["clojure", "-Srepro", "-Sdeps", deps, "-M", "-m", "evidence.host-cost",
                args.revision, str(HERE), str(out), baseline_checks, baseline_hash]
        env = os.environ.copy()
        for key in ["JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS", "_JAVA_OPTIONS", "CLJ_JVM_OPTS"]:
            env.pop(key, None)
        env["JAVA_OPTS"] = "-Xms256m -Xmx2g"
        assert time.monotonic() < work_deadline, "Preflight exhausted work budget"
        write_new(out / "command.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(ROOT), "started_utc": started_utc,
                                         "java_opts": env["JAVA_OPTS"], "work_s": WORK_SECONDS,
                                         "total_s": TOTAL_SECONDS, "baseline_checks_sha256": baseline_hash})
        with (out / "stdout.log").open("xb") as stdout, (out / "stderr.log").open("xb") as stderr:
            child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                     stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
            record_event({"event": "spawn", "pid": child.pid, "expected_pgid": child.pid,
                          "start_new_session": True})
            primary_identity = observe(child.pid)
            assert primary_identity is not None, "Primary start identity unavailable; spawn PID retained"
            assert primary_identity["pgid"] == child.pid, "Primary was not in its promised new process group"
            write_new(out / "primary-identity.json", primary_identity)
            while child.poll() is None:
                observe(child.pid)
                if time.monotonic() >= work_deadline:
                    timed_out = True
                    raise TimeoutError("170s work budget exhausted; partial results retained, no retry")
                time.sleep(min(0.1, max(0.0, work_deadline - time.monotonic())))
            rc = child.wait()
            if time.monotonic() >= work_deadline:
                timed_out = True
                raise TimeoutError("Child completion exceeded170s work deadline; late output retained as failed")
        assert rc == 0, f"Host-cost JVM exited {rc}"
        assert (out / "complete.edn").is_file(), "No complete marker"
        for name in ["checks.edn", "loaded-resources.edn", "empty.edn", "legacy-16.edn", "sculpt-1.edn", "sculpt-8.edn"]:
            assert (out / name).is_file(), f"Missing evidence {name}"
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = error_info(exc)
    finally:
        # Never retry the workload. Signals during cleanup must not skip reap.
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        if child is not None:
            cleanup_call("observe-before-cleanup", lambda: observe(child.pid))
            remaining = scan_owned()
            if cleanup_call("poll-before-cleanup", child.poll) is None or remaining:
                cleanup_call("terminate-owned-group", lambda: signal_owned(signal.SIGTERM))
                end_grace = min(total_deadline - 2.0, time.monotonic() + 8.0)
                while time.monotonic() < end_grace and scan_owned():
                    cleanup_call("poll-during-cleanup", child.poll)
                    time.sleep(0.05)
                if scan_owned() or cleanup_call("poll-before-kill", child.poll) is None:
                    cleanup_call("kill-owned-group", lambda: signal_owned(signal.SIGKILL))
            rc = cleanup_call("reap-owned-primary", lambda: child.wait(
                timeout=max(0.001, total_deadline - time.monotonic())), rc)
        live_group = scan_owned() if child is not None else []
        live_observed = []
        for pid, old in observations.items():
            now = cleanup_call(f"check-observed-{pid}", lambda pid=pid: membership(pid))
            if now and now["starttime_ticks"] == old["starttime_ticks"]:
                live_observed.append(now)
        if pins is not None:
            source_changed = cleanup_call("verify-final-source", lambda: [p for p, h in pins["candidate"].items()
                                          if not (ROOT / p).is_file() or digest(ROOT / p) != h], [])
        if prep is not None:
            prep_changed = cleanup_call("verify-final-preparation", lambda: [p for p, h in prep.items()
                                        if not (HERE / p).is_file() or digest(HERE / p) != h], [])
        cleanup_call("load-after", lambda: write_new(out / "load-after.json", load_snapshot()))
        cleanup_call("record-cleanup", lambda: record_event({"event": "cleanup", "exit_code": rc,
                     "remaining_group": live_group, "remaining_observed": live_observed,
                     "membership_unknown": membership_unknown, "cleanup_errors": list(cleanup_errors)}))
        artifacts = cleanup_call("hash-artifacts", lambda: {p.name: digest(p) for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file()}, {})
        finished = time.monotonic()
        total_deadline_exceeded = finished >= total_deadline
        status = "complete" if (error is None and rc == 0 and not live_group and not live_observed
                                and not source_changed and not prep_changed and not timed_out
                                and not cleanup_errors and not membership_unknown
                                and not total_deadline_exceeded) else "failed"
        result = {"status": status, "revision": args.revision, "started_utc": started_utc,
                  "ended_utc": utc(), "elapsed_s": finished - started,
                  "work_budget_s": WORK_SECONDS, "total_budget_s": TOTAL_SECONDS,
                  "total_deadline_exceeded": total_deadline_exceeded,
                  "error": error, "timed_out": timed_out, "exit_code": rc,
                  "pid_pgid": child.pid if child is not None else None,
                  "primary_identity": primary_identity,
                  "primary_reaped": child is not None and child.returncode is not None,
                  "observed_identities": history, "remaining_group": live_group,
                  "remaining_observed": live_observed, "cleanup": cleanup,
                  "cleanup_errors": cleanup_errors, "membership_unknown": membership_unknown,
                  "source_changed": source_changed, "preparation_changed": prep_changed,
                  "preparation_hashes": prep, "artifacts": artifacts,
                  "limit": "Polling may miss short children. Stat controls membership; optional exe/cwd denial is metadata. Unreadable membership or cleanup errors fail closure. Spawn/identity events are flushed/fsynced. OS/filesystem stalls can delay enforcement or prevent final persistence."}
        write_new(out / "execution.json", result)
        print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ["status", "revision", "elapsed_s", "exit_code", "error", "remaining_group", "remaining_observed"]}, indent=2))
    return 0 if status == "complete" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Offline real-supervisor tests; all process, signal and network effects are fakes."""
from contextlib import ExitStack, redirect_stdout
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def stat_text(pid, pgid, start=9876):
    fields = ["S", "0", str(pgid)] + ["0"] * 16 + [str(start)]
    return f"{pid} (fake process) " + " ".join(fields) + "\n"


class Clock:
    def __init__(self):
        self.now = 0.0

    def monotonic(self):
        return self.now

    def sleep(self, seconds):
        self.now += seconds


class SupervisorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.stack = ExitStack()
        self.addCleanup(self.stack.close)
        self.tmp = Path(self.stack.enter_context(tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=HERE)))
        self.proc = self.tmp / "proc"
        self.proc.mkdir()
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("offline_host_supervisor", HERE / "supervisor.py")
        self.m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(self.m)
        self.m.HERE = self.tmp
        self.m.ROOT = self.tmp
        self.m.PROC = self.proc
        real_path = Path

        def mapped_path(value):
            text = str(value)
            if text == "/proc" or text.startswith("/proc/"):
                return self.proc / text.removeprefix("/proc").lstrip("/")
            return real_path(value)

        self.m.Path = mapped_path
        self.clock = Clock()
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.time, "monotonic", self.clock.monotonic))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.time, "sleep", self.clock.sleep))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(subprocess, "Popen", side_effect=AssertionError("Real Popen blocked")))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(socket, "socket", side_effect=AssertionError("Network blocked")))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.os, "killpg", side_effect=AssertionError("Real signal blocked")))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.signal, "signal", return_value=None))
        self.links = {}

        def readlink(path):
            key = str(path).replace(str(self.proc), "/proc")
            if key in self.links:
                value = self.links[key]
                if isinstance(value, Exception):
                    raise value
                return value
            raise FileNotFoundError(key)

        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(self.m.os, "readlink", side_effect=readlink))
        self.add_proc(1, 1)
        self.links["/proc/1/exe"] = PermissionError("unrelated PID1 exe denied")
        self.links["/proc/1/cwd"] = PermissionError("unrelated PID1 cwd denied")

    def add_proc(self, pid, pgid, start=9876):
        path = self.proc / str(pid)
        path.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (path / "stat").write_text(stat_text(pid, pgid, start))
        child_dir = path / "task" / str(pid)
        child_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (child_dir / "children").write_text("")
        return path

    def deny_stat(self, pid):
        real_read = Path.read_text
        target = self.proc / str(pid) / "stat"

        def read(path, *args, **kwargs):
            if path == target:
                raise PermissionError("membership stat denied")
            return real_read(path, *args, **kwargs)

        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(Path, "read_text", read))

    def run_main(self, *, missing_identity=False, late_work=False, late_final=False,
                 cleanup_scan_error=False, running_failure=False):
        module, owner = self.m, self
        pid = 4242
        spawned = []
        signals = []
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(module, "verify_pins", return_value=({"candidate": {}}, {})))

        def load():
            if late_final and spawned and spawned[0].returncode is not None:
                owner.clock.now = 181.0
            return {"fake": True}

        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(module, "load_snapshot", side_effect=load))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(sys, "argv", ["supervisor.py", "baseline", "test-run"]))

        class Child:
            def __init__(self):
                self.pid = pid
                self.returncode = None
                self.polls = 0

            def poll(self):
                self.polls += 1
                if running_failure:
                    if self.polls == 1:
                        raise PermissionError("scripted work observation failure")
                    return self.returncode
                if self.polls == 1:
                    owner.links[f"/proc/{pid}/exe"] = "/fake/java"
                    return None
                self.returncode = 0
                (owner.proc / str(pid) / "stat").unlink(missing_ok=True)
                return self.returncode

            def wait(self, timeout=None):
                if self.returncode is None:
                    if running_failure:
                        raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired("fake child still running", timeout)
                    self.returncode = 0
                (owner.proc / str(pid) / "stat").unlink(missing_ok=True)
                if late_work:
                    owner.clock.now = 170.1
                return self.returncode

        def popen(argv, **kwargs):
            self.assertEqual(kwargs["stdin"], subprocess.DEVNULL)
            self.assertTrue(kwargs["start_new_session"])
            self.add_proc(pid, pid)
            if missing_identity:
                (self.proc / str(pid) / "stat").unlink()
            self.links[f"/proc/{pid}/exe"] = "/fake/clojure"
            self.links[f"/proc/{pid}/cwd"] = str(self.tmp)
            out = self.tmp / "runs/test-run"
            for name in ["complete.edn", "checks.edn", "loaded-resources.edn", "empty.edn",
                         "legacy-16.edn", "sculpt-1.edn", "sculpt-8.edn"]:
                (out / name).write_text("{:fake true}\n")
            child = Child()
            spawned.append(child)
            return child

        def killpg(group, number):
            signals.append((group, number))
            self.assertEqual(group, pid, "May signal only the newly owned group")
            spawned[0].returncode = -int(number)
            (self.proc / str(pid) / "stat").unlink(missing_ok=True)

        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(subprocess, "Popen", side_effect=popen))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(module.os, "killpg", side_effect=killpg))
        if cleanup_scan_error:
            self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(module, "group_members", side_effect=PermissionError("scan failed")))
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            rc = module.main()
        self.assertEqual(len(spawned), 1, "No retry or second child is permitted")
        result = json.loads((self.tmp / "runs/test-run/execution.json").read_text())
        return rc, result, spawned[0], signals

    def test_unrelated_optional_denial_does_not_abort_membership(self):

"""One explicitly released host-cost JVM; 170s work and 180s total, no retries."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
PROC = Path("/proc")
WORK_SECONDS = 170.0
TOTAL_SECONDS = 180.0
LABEL = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,48}\Z")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def utc():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def error_info(error):
    return {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}


def membership(pid):
    """Read authoritative group/start identity; only a vanished stat means absent."""
    try:
        fields = (PROC / str(pid) / "stat").read_text().rsplit(") ", 1)[1].split()
        return {"pid": pid, "state": fields[0], "pgid": int(fields[2]),
                "starttime_ticks": int(fields[19])}
    except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
        return None


def identity(pid):
    result = membership(pid)
    if result is None:
        return None
    result["metadata_errors"] = {}
    for name in ["exe", "cwd"]:
        try:
            result[name] = os.readlink(PROC / str(pid) / name)
        except OSError as error:
            result[name] = None
            result["metadata_errors"][name] = error_info(error)
    return result


def group_members(pgid):
    result = {"members": [], "unreadable": []}
    try:
        paths = list(PROC.iterdir())
    except OSError as error:
        result["unreadable"].append({"path": str(PROC), **error_info(error)})
        return result
    for path in paths:
        if path.name.isdecimal():
            pid = int(path.name)
            try:
                item = membership(pid)
            except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError) as error:
                result["unreadable"].append({"pid": pid, **error_info(error)})
                continue
            if item and item["pgid"] == pgid:
                result["members"].append(item)
    return result


def load_snapshot():
    java = []
    for path in PROC.iterdir():
        if path.name.isdecimal():
            try:
                executable = os.readlink(path / "exe")
            except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                continue
            if Path(executable).name == "java":
                java.append(identity(int(path.name)))
    return {"at": utc(), "loadavg": Path("/proc/loadavg").read_text().strip(),
            "aggregate_cpu": Path("/proc/stat").read_text().splitlines()[0],
            "visible_java_identities": [x for x in java if x is not None],
            "limit": "Endpoint census, not continuous proof of isolation; no commandlines/environment read."}


def write_new(path, value):
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


def verify_pins():
    prep = json.loads((HERE / "preparation-hashes.json").read_text())
    for relative, expected in prep.items():
        assert digest(HERE / relative) == expected, f"Preparation changed: {relative}"
    pins = json.loads((HERE / "source-pins.json").read_text())
    for relative, expected in pins["candidate"].items():
        assert digest(ROOT / relative) == expected, f"Source changed: {relative}"
    for relative in pins["baseline_overlay_paths"]:
        overlay = HERE / "baseline-overlay" / Path(relative).relative_to("src")
        assert digest(overlay) == pins["baseline"][relative], f"Wrong baseline overlay: {relative}"
    audit = json.loads((HERE / "criterium-source-audit.json").read_text())
    assert digest(Path(audit["jar"])) == audit["jar_sha256"], "Criterium jar changed"
    return pins, prep


def main():
    started = time.monotonic()
    started_utc = utc()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("revision", choices=["baseline", "candidate"])
    parser.add_argument("run_label")
    parser.add_argument("--baseline-run")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert LABEL.fullmatch(args.run_label), "Invalid fresh run label"
    assert args.baseline_run is None or LABEL.fullmatch(args.baseline_run), "Invalid baseline label"
    assert (args.revision == "candidate") == (args.baseline_run is not None), "Candidate requires completed baseline"
    out = HERE / "runs" / args.run_label
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    work_deadline = started + WORK_SECONDS
    total_deadline = started + TOTAL_SECONDS
    child = None
    observations = {}
    history = []
    error = None
    timed_out = False
    rc = None
    argv = None
    source_changed = []
    prep_changed = []
    cleanup = []
    cleanup_errors = []
    membership_unknown = []
    primary_identity = None
    pins = None
    prep = None
    journal = out / "ownership.jsonl"
    journal.touch(exist_ok=False)

    def record_event(event):
        with journal.open("a") as stream:
            json.dump(dict(event, at=utc(), elapsed_s=time.monotonic() - started), stream)
            stream.write("\n")
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())

    def observe(pid):
        item = identity(pid)
        if item is None:
            return
        previous = observations.get(pid)
        if previous != item:
            history.append(dict(item, elapsed_s=time.monotonic() - started))
            record_event({"event": "identity", "identity": item})
        observations[pid] = item
        try:
            descendants = (PROC / str(pid) / "task" / str(pid) / "children").read_text().split()
        except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
            return item
        for descendant in descendants:
            observe(int(descendant))
        return item

    def cleanup_call(stage, function, default=None):
        try:
            return function()
        except BaseException as failure:
            cleanup_errors.append({"stage": stage, **error_info(failure)})
            return default

    def scan_owned():
        result = cleanup_call("scan-owned-group", lambda: group_members(child.pid),
                              {"members": [], "unreadable": [{"reason": "Group scan failed"}]})
        for unknown in result["unreadable"]:
            if unknown not in membership_unknown:
                membership_unknown.append(unknown)
        return result["members"]

    def signal_owned(number):
        try:
            leader = membership(child.pid)
        except OSError as failure:
            # An unreaped live Popen child cannot have reused its PID. Preserve
            # unknown membership, but still terminate our known original group.
            membership_unknown.append({"pid": child.pid, **error_info(failure)})
            if child.poll() is not None:
                raise
            leader = None
        if (leader and primary_identity
                and leader["starttime_ticks"] != primary_identity["starttime_ticks"]):
            raise RuntimeError("Owned group leader PID was reused; refusing signal")
        if primary_identity is None and child.poll() is not None:
            raise RuntimeError("Missing primary start identity after exit; refusing group signal")
        try:
            os.killpg(child.pid, number)
            cleanup.append(f"sent {number.name} to owned process group")
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass

    def interrupt(_number, _frame):
        raise InterruptedError("Supervisor interrupted; owned cleanup required")

    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupt)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupt)
    try:
        pins, prep = verify_pins()
        baseline_checks, baseline_hash = "-", "-"
        if args.baseline_run:
            previous = HERE / "runs" / args.baseline_run
            previous_execution = json.loads((previous / "execution.json").read_text())
            assert previous_execution["status"] == "complete", "Baseline measurement did not complete"
            assert previous_execution["revision"] == "baseline", "Comparison source is not baseline"
            assert previous_execution["preparation_hashes"] == prep, "Baseline used different preparation"
            baseline_checks = str(previous / "checks.edn")
            baseline_hash = previous_execution["artifacts"]["checks.edn"]
            assert digest(Path(baseline_checks)) == baseline_hash, "Baseline checks changed"
        write_new(out / "load-before.json", load_snapshot())
        paths = ([str(HERE / "baseline-overlay")] if args.revision == "baseline" else [])
        paths += [str(ROOT / "src"), str(ROOT / "resources"), str(HERE)]
        deps = '{:paths [' + ' '.join(json.dumps(x) for x in paths) + '] :deps {criterium/criterium {:mvn/version "0.4.6"}}}'
        argv = ["clojure", "-Srepro", "-Sdeps", deps, "-M", "-m", "evidence.host-cost",
                args.revision, str(HERE), str(out), baseline_checks, baseline_hash]
        env = os.environ.copy()
        for key in ["JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS", "_JAVA_OPTIONS", "CLJ_JVM_OPTS"]:
            env.pop(key, None)
        env["JAVA_OPTS"] = "-Xms256m -Xmx2g"
        assert time.monotonic() < work_deadline, "Preflight exhausted work budget"
        write_new(out / "command.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(ROOT), "started_utc": started_utc,
                                         "java_opts": env["JAVA_OPTS"], "work_s": WORK_SECONDS,
                                         "total_s": TOTAL_SECONDS, "baseline_checks_sha256": baseline_hash})
        with (out / "stdout.log").open("xb") as stdout, (out / "stderr.log").open("xb") as stderr:
            child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                     stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
            record_event({"event": "spawn", "pid": child.pid, "expected_pgid": child.pid,
                          "start_new_session": True})
            primary_identity = observe(child.pid)
            assert primary_identity is not None, "Primary start identity unavailable; spawn PID retained"
            assert primary_identity["pgid"] == child.pid, "Primary was not in its promised new process group"
            write_new(out / "primary-identity.json", primary_identity)
            while child.poll() is None:
                observe(child.pid)
                if time.monotonic() >= work_deadline:
                    timed_out = True
                    raise TimeoutError("170s work budget exhausted; partial results retained, no retry")
                time.sleep(min(0.1, max(0.0, work_deadline - time.monotonic())))
            rc = child.wait()
            if time.monotonic() >= work_deadline:
                timed_out = True
                raise TimeoutError("Child completion exceeded170s work deadline; late output retained as failed")
        assert rc == 0, f"Host-cost JVM exited {rc}"
        assert (out / "complete.edn").is_file(), "No complete marker"
        for name in ["checks.edn", "loaded-resources.edn", "empty.edn", "legacy-16.edn", "sculpt-1.edn", "sculpt-8.edn"]:
            assert (out / name).is_file(), f"Missing evidence {name}"
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = error_info(exc)
    finally:

        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        if child is not None:
            cleanup_call("observe-before-cleanup", lambda: observe(child.pid))
            remaining = scan_owned()
            if cleanup_call("poll-before-cleanup", child.poll) is None or remaining:
                cleanup_call("terminate-owned-group", lambda: signal_owned(signal.SIGTERM))
                end_grace = min(total_deadline - 2.0, time.monotonic() + 8.0)
                while time.monotonic() < end_grace and scan_owned():
                    cleanup_call("poll-during-cleanup", child.poll)
                    time.sleep(0.05)
                if scan_owned() or cleanup_call("poll-before-kill", child.poll) is None:
                    cleanup_call("kill-owned-group", lambda: signal_owned(signal.SIGKILL))
            rc = cleanup_call("reap-owned-primary", lambda: child.wait(
                timeout=max(0.001, total_deadline - time.monotonic())), rc)
        live_group = scan_owned() if child is not None else []
        live_observed = []
        for pid, old in observations.items():
            now = cleanup_call(f"check-observed-{pid}", lambda pid=pid: membership(pid))
            if now and now["starttime_ticks"] == old["starttime_ticks"]:
                live_observed.append(now)
        if pins is not None:
            source_changed = cleanup_call("verify-final-source", lambda: [p for p, h in pins["candidate"].items()
                                          if not (ROOT / p).is_file() or digest(ROOT / p) != h], [])
        if prep is not None:
            prep_changed = cleanup_call("verify-final-preparation", lambda: [p for p, h in prep.items()
                                        if not (HERE / p).is_file() or digest(HERE / p) != h], [])

        cleanup_call("record-cleanup", lambda: record_event({"event": "cleanup", "exit_code": rc,
                     "remaining_group": live_group, "remaining_observed": live_observed,
                     "membership_unknown": membership_unknown, "cleanup_errors": list(cleanup_errors)}))
        artifacts = cleanup_call("hash-artifacts", lambda: {p.name: digest(p) for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file()}, {})
        finished = time.monotonic()
        total_deadline_exceeded = finished >= total_deadline
        status = "complete" if (error is None and rc == 0 and not live_group and not live_observed
                                and not source_changed and not prep_changed and not timed_out
                                and not cleanup_errors and not membership_unknown
                                and not total_deadline_exceeded) else "failed"
        result = {"status": status, "revision": args.revision, "started_utc": started_utc,
                  "ended_utc": utc(), "elapsed_s": finished - started,
                  "work_budget_s": WORK_SECONDS, "total_budget_s": TOTAL_SECONDS,
                  "total_deadline_exceeded": total_deadline_exceeded,
                  "error": error, "timed_out": timed_out, "exit_code": rc,
                  "pid_pgid": child.pid if child is not None else None,
                  "primary_identity": primary_identity,
                  "primary_reaped": child is not None and child.returncode is not None,
                  "observed_identities": history, "remaining_group": live_group,
                  "remaining_observed": live_observed, "cleanup": cleanup,
                  "cleanup_errors": cleanup_errors, "membership_unknown": membership_unknown,
                  "source_changed": source_changed, "preparation_changed": prep_changed,
                  "preparation_hashes": prep, "artifacts": artifacts,
                  "limit": "Polling may miss short children. Stat controls membership; optional exe/cwd denial is metadata. Unreadable membership or cleanup errors fail closure. Spawn/identity events are flushed/fsynced. OS/filesystem stalls can delay enforcement or prevent final persistence."}
        write_new(out / "execution.json", result)
        print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ["status", "revision", "elapsed_s", "exit_code", "error", "remaining_group", "remaining_observed"]}, indent=2))
    return 0 if status == "complete" else 1
